name: Civitavecchia (Italy)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Civitavecchia (an oak tree with the letters O and C on light blue) within branches, with the motto S.P.Q.C. on a scroll.
history: Municipal flag of Civitavecchia, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Civitavecchia arms — oak tree with the letters O and C on light blue, crowned, within branches
